scope: Source-state bodies shared literally by the aligned R1 and R2 returns are inventoried once. Their declared separate human decision process is preserved; literal equality neither proves nor disproves independence.
interpretation_limits: Matching bytes already in the historical workspace show a retrieval/routing distinction, not a new reading by either reviewer.
Internal receipts, extracted representations and bibliographic exports are not automatically missing primary trial reports.
Publication, registry and protocol candidates are classified by explicit provenance and verified payload structure where available; pertinence to the fixed target remains separate.
The 27 named investigation slots were already present in the original questionnaire; this lookup neither invents publications nor closes those bounded uncertainties.
No human source-access label or analytical result was overwritten by this technical reconciliation.
Absolute paths, private return text, copyrighted source full texts, prior classifications and rater identity metadata are not redistributed here.
